s1.syndrome_frame: Neurologic syndrome with intractable hiccups and leptomeningeal enhancement
salient_findings: Diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement on brain MRI
Lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features in cerebrospinal fluid
key_facts: 73-year-old man presented with intractable hiccups
Past medical history of chemotherapy and autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplant
Normal complete blood cell counts after transplant
Afebrile with normal vital signs
Normal neurologic examination except for hiccups
Brain MRI showed diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement and enhancement of several cranial nerves
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features
Flow cytometry showed κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation

shortlist.label: Lymphomatous meningitis
shortlist.why_kept: Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features and flow cytometry showed κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation

shortlist.label: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Brain MRI showed diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement and enhancement of several cranial nerves, consistent with CNS lymphoma

shortlist.label: Neurolymphomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Intractable hiccups and leptomeningeal enhancement on MRI suggest neurolymphomatosis, a rare condition involving lymphoma infiltration of the nervous system

shortlist.label: Waldenström macroglobulinemia
shortlist.why_kept: Lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features in cerebrospinal fluid and past medical history of chemotherapy and autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplant increase the likelihood of Waldenström macroglobulinemia

shortlist.label: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Flow cytometry showed κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, consistent with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma

raw.rationale: The presence of lymphocytosis with plasmacytoid features in the cerebrospinal fluid and flow cytometry showing κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, along with diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement on brain MRI, strongly supports the diagnosis of lymphomatous meningitis.

rejected.label: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
rejected.why: While this condition involves the central nervous system, the key finding of leptomeningeal enhancement and lymphocytosis in the cerebrospinal fluid points more specifically to lymphomatous meningitis.

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: This condition involves infiltration of the nervous system by lymphoma, but the specific findings of leptomeningeal enhancement and cerebrospinal fluid abnormalities are more characteristic of lymphomatous meningitis.

rejected.label: Waldenström macroglobulinemia
rejected.why: This is a type of lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma that primarily affects the bone marrow and does not typically present with the central nervous system findings seen in this patient.

rejected.label: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma
rejected.why: While the cerebrospinal fluid findings are consistent with a lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, the specific involvement of the leptomeninges and cranial nerves is more indicative of lymphomatous meningitis.
